model_description: AOSP model: 123 tensors, 88 ops, 5 history steps, 5 predicted steps
limitations: Unlabelled sessions cannot establish corner/reversal/pressure-specific acceptance
Offline endpoint error is not measured pen-to-photon latency
Rust kernels have not been cross-checked against the TensorFlow Lite runtime
Android fixed-rate and tilt adaptation require hardware validation; pretrained training-data provenance is not established
All methods scored on identical future targets; unavailable prediction falls back to current measured position
Existing predictors run in 96-DPI logical units at zoom 1; ML uses physical screen pixels; no heuristic tuning on these captures
